task: Multi-agent daily workflow: checks Gmail + Google Calendar, sorts the information, composes an HTML daily briefing dashboard.

design.shape: Schedule trigger fans out to two parallel Google branches; each branch aggregates its raw items and hands them to a specialist AI agent with a structured-output schema; a Merge syncs both analyses; a third agent composes the HTML dashboard; Gmail delivers it.
agents: Email Triage Agent - sorts unread mail into actionRequired / waitingOnOthers / fyi via structured output parser
Calendar Analyst Agent - turns today events into schedule / conflicts / focusBlocks via structured output parser
Briefing Composer Agent - renders the two JSON analyses into one inline-CSS HTML dashboard
design.sharedModel: One OpenAI Chat Model node (temperature 0.2) feeds all three agents via ai_languageModel connections.
deliberateChoices: alwaysOutputData: true on both Gmail and Google Calendar fetch nodes so the briefing still goes out on a day with an empty inbox or an empty calendar; both agent prompts are told to treat an empty/blank entry as 'nothing today'. This is the documented exception to the anti-pattern (the empty case has explicit downstream handling).
onError: continueRegularOutput on both fetch nodes so one failing Google API does not kill the whole briefing.

Merge (combine / combineByPosition) is used as a sync barrier only; the composer reads each analysis explicitly via $('Email Triage Agent').first().json.output and $('Calendar Analyst Agent').first().json.output to avoid the two agents' 'output' keys clashing on merge.
executeOnce: true on the composer agent (single summary call).
Google Calendar calendar id set to the well-known API alias 'primary' (not an invented value).
Recipient of the briefing email left as an SDK placeholder() - no email address invented.
No node groups: the canvas is small enough, and grouping would have forced splitting the one shared model node into three.
Skipped a webhook-served dashboard page (would need a second trigger plus persistence); the HTML dashboard is delivered as an HTML email instead.

credentials.policy: No credential created, no credential value invented. Nodes declare newCredential('...') slots only.
credentials.gmailNodes: Fetch Overnight Email / Send HTML Briefing - gmailOAuth2 slot saved empty, user must attach.
credentials.googleCalendarNode: Fetch Today Calendar - googleCalendarOAuth2Api slot saved empty, user must attach.
credentials.openAi: n8n auto-assigned an EXISTING user credential ('n8n free OpenAI API credits', type openAiApi) to the Briefing Model node at create time. Reported by create_workflow_from_code as autoAssignedCredentials source 'user'. Not created or chosen by the builder.
